That is not what is required of us. One must comprehend the absolute nature of truth. If we proceed in any other manner, it will constitute a grievous injustice perpetrated against humanity. The Divine will never condone such actions. The assertions of the Vedantins hold no truth. If one fails to discern the underlying reason why these great souls manifested only to endure such profound sorrow, then spiritual inquiry is ultimately futile. This constituted the core of my spiritual investigation. The Divine assisted me in discovering that precise cause. Furthermore, there exists a specific *karma* designed for their liberation. That very *karma* is the *Guru Pooja* performed at Santhigiri.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadina Poojitha Samarpana Pathippu 2002
Darshanasathyam

There exists a profound *karma* structured both in microscopic (atomic) and macroscopic (infinite) forms across the nine celestial spheres. Yogis chart their spiritual trajectory by situating this within the six *chakras* (*aadharas*) and relying upon that precise calculation. As one progresses in this manner, is it not imperative to recognize the entity that exists in the state of formlessness transcending the *Sapta Bhoomikas* (seven spiritual planes)? This profound reality remains imperceptible to the yogis. Until one transcends the realm of the *Navagrahas* (nine planetary spheres), the divine can only be perceived as an indistinct form. For the vision to attain absolute clarity, one's spiritual sight must penetrate the *mandalas* located beyond the *Navagrahas*. To transcend the *Navagrahas*, one must first cross the *Surya Mandala* (the solar plane). All other *mandalas* are positioned such that they envelop the sun. In order to transcend the *Surya Mandala*, the guidance of a Guru is indispensable. This is the ultimate reality. It is also the eternal law. We must actively seek to comprehend the Guru who has attained and established himself in the form of this sublime *mandala*. It is mandated that the presiding deity (*murti*) must be established within this devoted service to the Guru. Subsequently, one must rigorously investigate the specific epoch (*Yuga*) for which that Guru has manifested.

The *Treta Yuga* embodies a distinct truth. The *Dvapara Yuga* equally possesses its own unique truth. What, then, is the fundamental truth of this *Kali Yuga*? What is the merit in claiming that one will remain unaffected by the impurities of *Kali* while actively residing within this epoch? One must realize that it is strictly due to our immense spiritual fortune that we have obtained birth during the *Kali Yuga*. However, the presence of a Guru is absolutely essential to reveal the specific *karma* that serves as the root cause of this great fortune. This intrinsic *dharma* is the absolute truth. Can the truth ever be repudiated? That fundamental reality must be articulated meticulously in accordance with the specific calculations of each *mandala*. That constitutes our ultimate triumph.

Just as this earth has a sky, all other planets and stars have their respective skies. Without knowing about these skies and having a clear understanding of the stars, one cannot go beyond them. When the Prophet (Nabi) saw these nine planets (Navagrahas), he realized that the entire harvest of this flock resides in the moon. Therefore, he placed the moon in the position of karma. But no one else understood this. It was upon seeing this that the Prophet made his pleading prayer: "Oh Father, what have you shown before me, who had believed that there is nothing other than You!" The five daily prayers are a commemoration of this pleading prayer. But no one knows why he is pleading like this—"Why did you send me to this earth inhabited by these lowly people, and what should I do?" According to the laws of the body, this pain is inevitable for anyone, even for any great soul. Those who deny this are merely groping in the dark. The Prophet saw this in the ninth mandala. It was after witnessing the reality ripened therein that this pleading prayer was made. In that state, he sat in that burial ground for three months. And there he attained Samadhi.

It is only after I saw this that I understood this reality. When I became bewildered by the visions obtained from the state of the Devas, I could not comprehend the reasons for it. It took me nine years of searching for the cause of this bewilderment to make it clear to myself.

As far as a Yogi is concerned, he progresses by rejecting everything, saying "Not this, not this" (*Neti Neti*). How can they discard this karma that persists in this Manvantara calculation? For him, there is no karma. Fine, agreed. But who are the karmis (doers of action) associated with him? Do they not need the path of a Guru? If one says that it is not applicable to him, who will uphold this law of nature?

Having been born in the Kali Yuga, we cannot perform the karma of the Treta Yuga. There is no other logic than to understand what its karma is and perform it. Kali is equally applicable to everyone—human, Deva, Rishi, Jnani, Karmi, Bhakta, and Yogi. Only a Guru can provide guidance by recognizing what exists and instructing one to act accordingly. Stating any other logic will not be correct. It is because there was no one among us to understand this and behave accordingly that numerous arguments emerged.

It is indeed true that Islam says God has no form. The formless is a stream of light. Light does have a form. There are hundred, two hundred, or five hundred-watt bulbs, as well as zero-watt bulbs. All of these emit light. If there is light, it has a form too. The only difference is that there are variations in that form. Therefore, what is needed first is to believe that light has variations in form. When this is the truth, who can say that this truth does not exist?

It is when one believes thus that the existence of evil spirits (Pishachas) is perceived. In what all states does a Pishacha exist? The Pishacha exists even up to the state of Brahmarakshas. This Brahmarakshas is referred to as 'Mahan' (great one). Brahmarakshas means one who has progressed aiming solely at Brahman. Where will this end up? They have progressed by rejecting everything, saying "it does not exist, it does not exist," without performing karma. What is the use of someone ascending there while denying the entities in God's conception? Because they are not permitted to ascend there, these forces remain in the middle realms. In the middle of this atmosphere, they stand like absolute aggressors.

I once asked Swami Jagadeeswarananda about this. He is the one who taught the *Brahmasutra* to Swami Agamananda. He had passed the Shastri examination. He had also enrolled and studied in the Vedanta class in Kashi. He spent twenty-one years there studying and teaching. During the time he was teaching the *Brahmasutra* to Agamananda, I was living in the southernmost room of the magazine office near the Samadhi. At that time, I had a habit of waking up late in the night. Jagadeeswarananda used to notice this. I did not know that he was noticing it. I would get up, walk a little along the road, and reach near where they were staying. At one end of the courtyard there, a woven palm leaf was placed. I would go and sit on it for some time. Then I would go to sleep. One day he came and sat next to me, saying, "You rogue." He sat next to me and talked for a while, saying, "Wasn't I watching where you went?" Then I asked him about the clarity and obscurity of light—neither clear, yet not obscure. It has a form. Therefore, it cannot be said to be obscure. But it has no form. I used to see such things. Then he said, "Oh child, you should not ask me about matters of vision. I only have the knowledge that Dr. Sivananda told me such a thing exists."

Rishikesh Sivananda and he had studied together. Rishikesh Sivananda later went to Kashi and lived there in a hut for twelve years. He also used to chant the *Hare Rama* stotram. Through that, he received three or four visions. He mentioned this matter. This Sivananda was a doctorate holder. But he went to Rishikesh saying that this paper was not even fit for scooping bran. While living there, he got a boil on his leg. He could neither walk nor sit. He even suffered the fate of having to crawl on the road. If a poor man lies there, who will pay attention? Then Jagadeeswarananda saw him, hired a horse carriage, and took him to the hospital. He mentioned this matter during their conversation then. He only knows about this from what he had heard him say. He told me that otherwise, he had not even seen the light of a lit incense stick. He knows that this exists. The scriptures say so. But there is no such familiarity among us. There is absolutely no knowledge about the paths suitable for the soul's spiritual merit (Atmasukrutham). It is because even the Sanyasis lack that knowledge that our homes have become ruined. Even families living with some traditional knowledge do not know how to carry forward devotion. There are many ancestors who ended up getting stuck after worshipping Brahmarakshas, Yogi, Karmi, etc. This is the blunder that has befallen all households. This evil spirit has taught them ignorance. When the children in that house grow up, they will become ignorant. I have the experience of interacting with thousands of such families. It was upon seeing the subtle form of this ignorance that these great men cried out in such panic.

There is karma shared here as Deva, Devi, Jnani, Rishi, and Sanyasi. Who can deny this by saying it does not exist? Even in the Rishi tradition, there are those who have reached up to the state of Brahmarakshas. We know that Narada was a Rishi. Which world did this Narada reach and stand in? What is the sense of pride of that world? They lived and demonstrated it before departing.

Saying that what our ancestors worshipped does not exist does not make it non-existent. This certainly exists. What should we do with this? We must take this and surrender it to a Guru or to God. There is no other logic for this. There are Jivatmas in this who have been stuck for epochs. These are karmas that have come after the Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga. When the time of Sri Krishna arrived, its base was in Krishna. Krishna became its authority. But we could not revere and accept Krishna. What did we do there? We bothered to interpret and complete the meaning of Vedanta. But that is not what Krishna did. That is why Krishna said, "Arjuna, you are not killing anyone, nor are you causing anyone to be killed."
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarpanappathippu 2002
The Experience of Santhigiri

About five hundred of the people who have been visiting our ashram are experienced. Once they arrive here, they must see me. Otherwise, they will be deeply distressed. When they are unable to see me for many days in such a manner, they will experience certain psychological deficiencies. That is the greatest wrong that can be done to them. Therefore, you must not use rules to stop them. Their experience might be small. But for them, it is significant. This fact must be known to those who stand here and to others. You cannot understand what their specific matter is just by looking at them. They also cannot understand the reason why you are stopping them. It is enough for them to just see me. Their pain will vanish. Otherwise, they will face insurmountable difficulties. After a while, it might even turn into a psychological problem. Hence, if someone feels that they absolutely must see me, you must allow them to do so.

Looking at the nature of some people, one might even wonder if they have any love or faith. No one can understand that. There are many such individuals. This does not mean that they have attained great spiritual states. Some people cause me distress the moment they leave their homes. That does not mean I should not see them. I may be experiencing distress due to the deficiency of their soul or their inherent tendencies. Nevertheless, it must be endured. You must be very careful not to cause them any pain. Similarly, we must be very attentive when serving them food. All of this is a matter related to devotion. If these things are not handled in their proper manner, it will generate a sinful power.

Even those who have been at the ashram for ten or twenty years lack the knowledge of how to handle matters here. For some, whether male or female, these are things that must essentially be done for them. You must consider this as the right of their soul. For some others, even if such things are not done, they have no trouble at all. They will acquire everything by seeing, hearing, knowing, and experiencing. For a soul, all this is necessary until a certain stage is crossed. Some have a lack of ability to understand on their own.

Some people may behave half-crazed. We must never lose our temper with them. We should call them, seat them, advise them on good things, and then send them away. Otherwise, they will suffer from a psychological lack of growth. Even if I say a word to them in jest, that is enough to satisfy them. Out of a hundred people, maybe two will have such problems. Those who stand near me must know many such things.

Here, you must not consider caste or religion. Those are very troubling matters. If some souls happen to leave in sorrow, it will bring certain detriments not only to you but also to the ashram. We must never obstruct the right of a soul. You may feel that they are completely worthless. But you do not know the right of their soul, do you? Whatever the cost, you must impart peace to them before letting them go. Have you not seen me speaking for them on certain occasions, no matter how physically unwell I am? It will not be right if you rigidly adhere to the rules.

Another thing is that some people will feel mentally suffocated, unable to stay here even for two days. Those who stand here must know that matter as well. You must also communicate this among yourselves and understand. Have you not seen me calling some people privately and speaking to them, no matter how lacking in knowledge they are? On some days, at least a thousand such people will come. Can I deal with all of them alone? If, in those situations, you show them the rules instead of showing love and patience, what can I do? You must show affection to everyone. You must not behave toward them like a peon in a government office.

During the time I was wandering, there were many such experiences. No one has ever stopped me. But at the time when I wish to see, I must see certain people. Otherwise, there will be distress. This desire of the mind is a very serious matter. If the circumstances are not right, you may stop them. But you must speak good words to them peacefully. We can see the Guru, you can see and then go, please calm down a little ... When the opportunity arises, you must allow them to see me. They cannot tell you the matter that they have to tell me privately, can they? They can only leave after saying it. Otherwise, they will face great distress. Out of a thousand people, about three hundred people have matters for which they need to see me. About four or five people must see me right then. If they do not see me then, they will experience indescribable distress. If we do not understand and handle this properly, it will become contrary to the will of God. God has such a determination, hasn't He? The goodness that we strive to achieve should not go in vain.

There are some families who come and stay here for days. Such people are not like those who are fine even if they don't get to see (me). They absolutely must see. That is a necessity of their soul. Therefore, we must show compassion to their soul. Do not withhold that compassion. Regarding some people, you might assume, since they see (me) every day, why do they have such great agonies. Do not assume so. It is an issue of their minds becoming corrupted. Similarly, there are some who stay here rendering service. Whenever they feel like seeing, they must see and say certain things. Otherwise, they wouldn't feel like coming here for several days. If they go, those standing there won't allow them to see, then why should they go there—in that sense, they won't come later. Then, it might develop into a small resentment and that resentment will continue. Even if those standing here cannot be careful about this, those who come should have this understanding. Not everyone may have this understanding and love. Therefore, we must act according to the situation, speak in good language, and remove the rigidity of their minds. No matter how difficult it is, you must show that. You should not keep them away by citing other procedures.

When some people come, you might feel that when they were given an opportunity, they stood aloof, and now they have barged in. But that is how they are. They will come when they feel like it, do things when they feel like it, and leave when they feel like it. Even if they cannot see me, they have a desire to receive some *Prasadam* (offering). They must be allowed to leave only after being given the *Prasadam*. If you do not do so, a lapse will occur on account of that. If that lapse happens, no matter how great the things you do, your compassion will be lost. This will cause harm to your life.

I am entrusting you with the work of removing the stains from the souls of others, which I have established—that you should do things in such and such a manner. After entrusting you with that duty (*Karma*), I am not asking you to observe any severe vows or austerities. Without such severe observances, would anyone normally agree to let you surrender all your flaws? Can any individual take upon themselves the flaws of even a single person? What is being done here? You have found a place to unload thousands or crores of burdens. What is the secret of this? As long as you do not understand this, there is no point in my saying any of this.

I am not teaching anything to anyone in a structured manner. When they gain experience, I will take some time and speak to such people. Everyone realizes for themselves the old tendencies of the soul, the course of *Dharma*, and what errors have occurred in that *Dharma*. Like the saying *Jagrat, Swapna, Sushuptinam Sakshi Poorti* (perfect witness to the waking, dream, and deep sleep states), the Guru, standing as a witness, transforms your *Karma*. After that, you ascend to the different states of *Turiya* and *Turiyatita*. For that, you only need to depend on the Guru. You do not need to look up to any deity, sage, or spirit. All these will appear before you even without you calling them. What you elders do not get, your children will get. There is a saying for this here: If given to elders, they will ruin it. As for children, as they grow, this experiential aspect will grow in their flesh, blood, and marrow, and it will also grow in their intellect. Along with that, love, humility, and respect will also grow. Instead, what do the elders say? "I have seen and known a lot in life; I am superior to others." On top of that, they will read the *Bhagavata* and explain its meaning. Likewise, they will talk about the *Puranas* as well.

I am not talking about any of these. I am talking about the *Karma* that is the cause of these *Puranas* and *Itihasas*. That *Karma* is the *Gurupooja* that I have done for you. By performing that *Karma* and removing the base elements in each course of *Karma*, the great ones are maintained as great ones. They are elevated slightly from where they stood. Just as you were born and came here, through the Guru, you will be saved by the recurring special feature of the *Dharma* across future lifetimes. There is no distinction of male or female, young or old for this. Everyone who has the innate fortune for it will receive it. Thus, by the seventh generation, you will become a pure human lineage. You need not show any vanity, boastfulness, or justification in this. This is something to be achieved even at the risk of your life. There is no meaning in saying that you spent time or money for this purpose. That talk is ignorance; it is empty prattle.

This knowledge must first arise in the wealthy. Only if there are wealthy people can any good be done for the land. The *Karma* combining knowledge, humility, respect, and fortune will come only through him. When a certain *Karma* proves useful, if the machine that deceives man can perform some aspects of maturing a human being, what cannot be achieved if you walk the path through that truth! By wandering around Kashi, Rameswaram, Vrindavan, Ayodhya, and going to Rishikesh and Badrinath, you will not grasp even one aspect of this truth. You are not going to gain this virtue by wandering around using your status and spending money. Haven't you seen the ministers and great leaders here going to see the Lord? They can go and see the Lord anywhere, anytime, right? For some other leaders, they don't have to go anywhere to see. They can see directly from where they sit. If there is socialism, they can see quite a bit more. I am not speaking for them. It is for you. If politicians are beaten with thorns, their skin peels, and blood flows, it is good for them. They can flaunt themselves as martyrs, right? It is always good for him. Whether he dies or not, it is a virtue. Aren't you swallowing all this foolishness and attaining absolute freedom? Falling into this complete trickery called absolute freedom, dying and rotting without liberation from *Tantras*, *Mantras*, or any kind of liberation at all—what else is special about it?

Didn't I tell you earlier, pour out all your sinful energies, let them all be exhausted. For that, I will not say that you must observe any celibacy (*Brahmacharya*) or vow. But I will say that you must live without forsaking *Dharma*. When you realize what that *Dharma* is, celibacy will naturally become a safeguard for it. No one needs to tell you to do so. When you understand for yourself what you need through that discipline, it will happen on its own. Then you will not go wrong anywhere.

What is celibacy (*Brahmacharya*)? When you finish performing *Gurupooja*, this god, goddess, sage, ascetic, and everything else come, bow down before the Guru, and attain liberation. At least one child in the house performing *Gurupooja* will see this. It is not enough if you do *Gurupooja* alone. It will not be effective if the rest of the family stays away. At the very least, the father, mother, and children in the house should see this as the truth. Once the *Gurupooja* is done, you should not invite any other calamities. If you say that the grandmother and grandfather were accustomed to it, so I cannot help but be accustomed to it too, then nothing can be done. What is this habit? That it is enough to call out "Narayana" at the time of death. Another one is that, when angry, there is no satisfaction unless some wicked things are spoken. There is a sense of pleasure in uttering twisted words that somehow destroy a person and bring disrespect to the Guru. This is a kind of trickery. How many such families do we have! All this is the remnant of ignorance imparted by foolishness. This has completely destroyed our *Dharma*.

By performing Guru Pooja, the path to the spiritual merit (atma sukrutham) of gods, goddesses, sages, and ascetics is cleared. That is why one is able to see all those forces directly. I am not saying that spiritual merit has been achieved, but the path to it has been cleared. The dharma that can be directly experienced is realized here. What use is it to you if I perform some kind of impersonation instead of this? What has actually happened here? The baseness that resided in your life has been completely destroyed. How many crores of rupees would it cost to achieve this?

What is the experience in a home where Guru Pooja is performed? How do the past Gurus stand, how do the sages and the wise stand, and how does it radiate light into the ages to come? This is the familiarity that the children in your home acquire to witness this. By standing as a witness in all three states of waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, the Guru extracts both your good and bad. Giving the good to your life, he accepts the bad and destroys it. Thus, you become purified in the karmic aspect known as the purity of the vessel. That Karma Yoga is what is being given to you.

Oh Godٹ. Oh Guruٹ. Just this one call. You do not need to do anything more than this for it. Your karma is reaching the destiny of your home, land, and country. Having ten children as mentioned earlier is enough to achieve this Karma Yoga. Then what did you get as the guardians of these children? The merit of being able to donate your children for the land and the country. With that, your lineage prospers. But if you cannot preserve such a great karma, there will be destruction of that magnitude. God gave you the opportunity to take up God's karma and to become its owners. Do not hoard it, quarrel over it, and trample it down. Not even a single word in this regard should be trampled down. You do not have the authority to trample it down even with a single glance. You should work entirely for goodness and preserve this for the spiritual merit of the children across multiple births. That merit is a karma that becomes the Guru, becomes God, and helps in attaining salvation across births.

What are you placing and offering in the place of God? A venomous snake. This is your tradition. Life must be transformed into different states. Then, standing as a human, standing as a god, standing as a sage, and transforming this tradition, our Guru Pooja is the theory of evolution of a soul waiting for the spiritual merit across births. Will God be in your hands no matter how many crores you spend? If so, God should be in the hands of those who spend thirty and fifty crores to build temples.

I am not telling you any of this. Giving a share of what you eat, a share of what you drink, showing decency in everything you do, and behaving with mutual respect towards each other, just one call "Oh God" is enough. You should call nothing else but "Oh God, Oh Guru". Because that call is not mine, it becomes yours. Because God has given you and me the opportunity to be born and made you my contemporaries. There should be no stubbornness among yourselves, and no lack of humility. "He is my brother, she is my sister, if they suffer a shortcoming, it is my shortcoming too, and taking it upon myself is my dharma." I am asking from you children who will put this into practice and show it. You do not need to do anything else for me. Instead, if you raise your children, husband, and wife according to your desires, get hurt, and fall into the core of sorrow, I will not be able to do anything. I am giving you the karmic ability to voluntarily withdraw from that sorrow.

What should you think about? When your children grow up near you, what all should you give them to raise them? You who live by blaming your husband, blaming your wife, and blaming your children must understand one truth—all this is your predestined karma.

I have not spoken Vedanta to you. I have only told you the truth from my experience to the best of my knowledge. You must take it completely. This is my requirement. This is not a careless asceticism. It is an asceticism that has come through sacrifices over multiple births. No one will get this without making sacrifices. I am giving you the proof of that sacrifice. If you want, you can take this and believe it. I am not asking if you have the knowledge for it or not. I am not asking your caste or religion. I am not teaching that you will benefit if you stay separated from your wife or husband. I am not saying to leave her if she is no good. Look after them as much as possible, if there is no other way, then let go.

The Malayarayars have a specific tradition when they go to meet the king. They retain the bottom-most node of a bamboo stalk and knock off all the others. The topmost portion is sealed with wax. They fill this bamboo with honey and delicacies made of flattened rice, bring it before the king, toss all these items backward, and then fall forward to offer their obeisance. The obeisance is performed with hands placed behind the back. What was the consequence of their custom being such? The devil, blessed by the frenzied dancing of these Kappiris (spirits), stands there. It is this devil that makes them don such costumes. The *Theyyam* dance and similar practices have evolved through continuous refinements of this custom. This represents our primitive method of invoking the divine. We must critically reflect upon what we stand to gain from such practices.

Do not raise children by merely providing them with education and wealth, thereby making them useless to society. They must be given what is ordained by their destiny. You must formulate the destined karma, the karma that they are meant to assimilate through their lives. This is the karma for you to unite with me. Apart from this, you should not assume that you can achieve anything else by living in this world. It is your accomplishment to be able to cultivate such a karma and a corresponding faith. Ultimately, that will translate into the world's accomplishment. This constitutes the secret of *Guru Puja*. It is the light serving as the foundation of this karma that the children here perceive being revered by gods, goddesses, sages, ancestors, ascetics, and even the *Trimurtis*, including Maha Vishnu. And then they declare, "Children ٹ, do not let this go astray; for their salvation depends entirely on keeping this flawless."

This is what you must take as evidence, rather than attributing this to any kind of mystical power of mine. If I stretch out my hand, nothing will appear from thin air. I do not possess the magical knowledge to stretch out my hand and produce gold. I only possess what God has bestowed upon me. I share that with you. By sharing this and putting you through difficulties, I pray that you attain the fruits of your past life's struggles. Thus, when the contemplation of the soul becomes firmly established in you, you must realize what spiritual merit (*Atmasukrutham*) is—this is my desire.

What is meant by this difficulty? Did I not say earlier, "Let everything of mine be yours, both the bad and the good." When such a dedication occurs, certain afflictions will befall the body and mind. Can you at least conceptualize this? You will not attain this from any other place. They will simply tell you to worship anyone you please. Or else, they will instruct you to worship by including this or that specific item.

Here, by performing the *Guru Puja*, we are revealing to your children the karmic potential that encompasses everything from spirits and ghosts residing in Vaishnava, Shaiva, and Shaktheya concepts, up to deities, sages, and ascetics. It is not I who am demonstrating this. It is an agency of God. God is manifesting in my form. Having assumed such a form, the divine appears before you in accordance with your conception.

Have you not heard of Uddhava? History states that Uddhava looked exactly like Sri Krishna. When Uddhava developed a doubt, Krishna told him, "Then go to a house where I am not present." Wherever he went, Krishna was there. Uddhava was no ordinary person, after all. He was well-versed in philosophy and Vedanta. His doubt was why Krishna was manifesting before these women (the Gopis). It was to understand this that Uddhava went to them. When Uddhava arrived, it was Krishna whom they saw. They asked, "Why did you take the trouble to come here? Had you called, we would have come to you." Upon comprehending this experience, Uddhava was terrified. These women were masters of their own minds. For many lifetimes, they had been *Brahmavadinis*. *Brahmavadinis* are those who perceive the ultimate form within Brahman and expound upon it. They are beings who have taken billions of births. The vision is granted to such evolved souls. How can ordinary people understand this? These Gopi women, being *Brahmavadinis*, were perceiving the form of Krishna within Brahman. How have you understood such a Sri Krishna?

What you are witnessing is the vision of Krishna coming and bowing down to the Guru who has carried forward that tradition without letting it be lost. You must not assume that it is me whom Krishna is bowing to. Brahman has assumed my form and stands before you. That is what is being revered.

There is a story in the *Bhagavata*. A Yaksha took a blade of grass and threw it into the assembly of Devendra. Then he called the Devas one by one. First, Agni (the god of fire) was called. He could not burn that blade of grass. Then Varuna was summoned, but he failed. Vayu also failed. No one could even move this blade of grass. Then Devendra declared that the one who had come as the Yaksha was Brahman. The Devas were unable to perceive the true nature of Brahman. The soul capable of seeing this was bestowed with the title of Devendra. That is, he was granted the position as the Indra of the Devas. However, even such a Devendra acted foolishly. That is why he incurred the curse of Sage Gautama.

If we live recognizing the truth in history, how can you realize the truth without properly cultivating the ability, competence, love, and corresponding reverence to grasp it? All of this is evident. But even the soul that experienced this direct realization has no liberation. That is what Devendra's experience proves. So, what is the inherent spiritual competence required to transcend into the state of liberation? This is what we must actualize through our lives.

This experience rests in your hands as clearly as a gooseberry, or like yielding gold. You must manifest this in your lives. It depends entirely on your unity and your way of life. Forgetting caste, religion, and class, you must unite as one, and the merit of that karma must reflect in your ancestral lineage (*pitrutvam*). Then, transforming into deities and sages, they must be born as children in your homes. The *Guru Puja* performed here serves as the guiding light for this karma.

What is your comprehension today, what is your requirement, and what is your absolute necessity? What is the truth that emanates from it? It is to comprehend this that you ought to come here. One need not become an ascetic to acquire this from here and impart it to one's children. In the disposition of men and women born as human beings, the female householder (*Grihadharmini*) who adheres to the duties of household life (*Grihadharma*) must be exceptionally competent. The obligation to render her husband worthy also resides with her. It is such a woman who is elevated to the stature of a *Brahmavadini*. In the householder's stage of life (*Grihasthashrama*), one should not anticipate miracles; rather, it is an earnest endeavor to perceive the light of truth. In that endeavor, the husband, wife, and children immerse themselves together. It is for that specific undertaking that you are instructed to surrender everything here. Merely surrendering everything is insufficient; one must also pray fervently.

What is the nature of prayer? It is not merely chanting while sitting with folded hands. Whatever task you perform, you should pray. Prayer must permeate every action. It should reach all virtuous actions as well as base actions. The Guru will elevate this prayer from all those actions. That is why it is said: word is truth, truth is Guru, and Guru is God. You must experience that divine presence. To experience this most subtle of subtle truths, one must transcend the states of wakefulness (*Jagrat*), dream (*Swapna*), and deep sleep (*Sushupti*) and ascend higher. This is a truth that no one has ever articulated before. By witnessing, hearing, and knowing this, make your life blessed. Through that, you will acquire the capability and competence to rectify the errors committed by your father, mother, or ancestors. That must be attained from God. That is our immense fortune.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadina Poojitha Samarppana Pathippu 2002
What Those Living in the Lineage of the Guru Must Heed

We possess a culture that has led a severely degraded manner of living. Because knowledge is highly constricted, there is an arrogance within all of us that authority is the benchmark of knowledge. The ego of 'I' exists in all human beings. There are even those who harbor resentment for being criticized. They lack the wisdom to realize that being corrected is beneficial. Ignorance is more prevalent among women. Irrespective of age, shortcomings exist among both the lowest and the highest strata. The majority of girls live without ever contemplating where they were born, why they were born, or how they were raised. They possess an inclination to merely dress up and wander about, completely unwilling to do any work or get any work done. Each individual is far removed from their respective duties. This condition has arisen because every household possesses a lineage of living in ignorance for an extended period. It is a tradition of living a sedentary life, consuming without ever engaging in labor. Each one of us is the progeny of this depravity. Caste-based conflicts can be observed everywhere. Aside from engaging in such struggles, no one knows how to contemplate the proper upbringing of girls.

If this practice is to change, an appropriate administration must emerge. For that to happen, one must pray with an aching heart, beseeching the eradication of the ignorance that has infiltrated this human society. Pray also that this land does not deteriorate due to our overflowing passions. Pray that all the absurdities witnessed in this world be reduced to ashes and perish. The foremost thing you must do is to implore God, asking for a way to remove these deficiencies from our progeny, and for the mindset and action required to achieve it. You will undoubtedly experience transformation.

You possess a lack of administrative experience. The deficiencies of those who perished by committing treachery in governance can only be rectified through divine grace. Maintaining strict discipline in prayer will yield immense results. You are individuals who are incapable of loving one another by speaking kind words. No matter how much improvement occurs, a sense of deficiency remains deep within. One must pray for deceptive thoughts to depart from the world entirely.

What great souls proclaim does not materialize immediately. Believing the words of Jesus that heaven would arrive, one had to wait for 1500 years. Work must be executed swiftly. Otherwise, impurity will adulterate the action. While performing an action, it must be done with noble intentions. When those who have acted in such a manner are reborn, they will possess 10 hands (extraordinary capability). Yet, they will not exhibit corresponding arrogance.

An opportunity similar to what Moses received was bestowed upon India in the exact same measure. However, a submissive nature of worship, incapable of seizing that opportunity, had already been prevailing here. According to Hindu scriptures, there were four eras (*Chaturyugas*). Preceptors (*Acharyas*) existed as authorities for each *Chaturyuga*. Prior to the commencement of the *Kali Yuga*, Sri Krishna arrived and rejected all the rituals that had existed until then. Yet, all the actions of Sri Krishna became submerged in myths. Krishna was tethered among gods and goddesses. That should never have happened. Krishna declared that one should forsake everything that existed until then and worship him alone. Moses was not as pure a soul to that extent. When Moses was born, the people were slaves of the Pharaoh. The Pharaoh knew beforehand that Moses would be born among these downtrodden people. Therefore, he continually executed all the newborn male children. The background of Sri Krishna's birth was also exactly like this, was it not? When the Pharaoh killed all the male children, Moses' parents somehow raised their son in hiding and prayed fervently. Then, they set him afloat in the water. The king's daughter and her maids saw him, realized he was a slave child, and entrusted him back to his own mother. She raised him until the age of 4 and then handed him back to the palace. During none of these instances was Moses imparted with spiritual wisdom. Upon reaching adulthood, while living in hiding at a shepherd's house, he married an honest girl in accordance with the divine word he received. It was there that his baptism of wisdom occurred.

India is the birthplace of numerous great souls. Consequently, the *Varnashrama Dharma* and the *Trimurti* system are, in reality, unnecessary for India. The Prophet had received revelations. However, it was also stated that it would be conveyed only when requested. The prayer conducted at Santhigiri has been revealed from the Supreme Light. When that prayer was practiced, since 1973, everything began to be fulfilled for us. It is the girls who have received the immense fortune to perform this. Through this, we have also been able to eradicate the corruption that caused the degradation of women.

Because they were able to believe and act upon what the Prophet proclaimed 1500 years ago, it has become a reality today. Similarly, even if the present generation does not comprehend what is being stated today, God has a specific purpose in making us pray and act at present. Everything revealed here has been meticulously preserved here. It cannot be disclosed now. It can only be revealed after this generation.

The foundational nature of all the affairs of our ashram has been derived through prayer. A situation will emerge in the future where the world will understand the purpose behind our prayers. An action named 'Completion' was performed here 34 times. Those completions were in the nature of the 27 constellations. In 1973, 27 of them were completed. It was on the day the 27th was completed that the revelation was received: "The matters I had desired across eons have been fulfilled."

This atmosphere is filled with the germs of perfection. Men and women handle things very carefully here. Their every word, every look and every expression will be absorbed into this atmosphere and linger. It will never fade from their lives. This is the stage where Dayananda Saraswathi, Rishikesham Sivanandan, Sankarachariyar – everyone has failed. If you can use your ability and energy for this, there is no greater fortune.

It is your work that I love, not money. This idea is the result of a great sacrifice and I need the determination and pain to sacrifice anything to honor it. Humility, and along with humility, a care in speech, Appa! I do many things, I make many things happen; you must also maintain a pleading prayer that you should always make me do according to your will. This will only be correct if there is a dedication to offer one's life for this. Those who work today, even if they are a child, if they carry this forward without mistake, there is no doubt that their names will be etched in the pages of history. It may perhaps take one or two generations for that.

This fortune is something your ancestors did not get. This fortune is one that will never be subjugated to anything or anyone. The great sinful power of killing the Prophet's children and seizing power is the reason why murder and killing happen wherever Muslims take power. Therefore, your life and the mischief in life must be untied and resolved here.

The experience here is like getting a new earth. Before getting it, one does not know what it is. Earth here refers to the body. Many things are stored in the godown of the heart. It should be kept without spoiling. No matter how hard it is, one must be able to complete it. A state should be reached where we do not need both sin and merit. If merit is earned, then one has to be born again to experience its fruit. If you strengthen your mind, no one can defeat you. You cry when pain comes. Even through that crying, you must pray that you can do His will.

We do not need Siddhi. Siddhi is a feature of a time. It is enough if Siddhi works as a feature of that time. Siddhi is not needed for this time. Sree Krishna showed the complete nature of Siddhi and stopped. Hereafter, Siddhi is not allowed. God is leading us to the Satya Yuga. For that, one must do there and take here. You do not have to do anything for God. You have to do it with a broken heart and take the fruit of that pain. Do not act and repeatedly let the mind go into mischief. If you have done even an inch, you should never go back. Everyone's good qualities should be modeled. There is something to learn even from a small creature. By learning from everything, you must have the determination that at least one person should become good through my action.

The greatest Guru of a Manu lineage will get ten male and ten female disciples. That depends on the Guru's luck. Among these, three will be excellent, seven will be mediocre, and the rest will be those who reach only up to God-light. They will not merge in Brahma-light. However many others were in that Manu lineage, in the next birth they will attain salvation only as members or servants of this Guru lineage. There is another group, those who have vision, rise a little and then fall without doing anything. Another group are family people. They will carry everything in moderation, lead a family life and eventually attain salvation. Or they will join the Guru. Neither of these two groups should have doubts about the Guru. If any doubt arises like that at any time, one can attain salvation by confessing to the Guru that a doubt arose about the Guru at such a time, and seeking a remedy. Even householders can reach the state of the Trinity if they do not make mistakes. Or if a mistake is made, depending on the magnitude of the mistake, they will be born many times and at some time accept the discipleship of an elevated Guru of this Guru lineage and attain salvation through that. People who come to the group of this Guru or Guru lineage and stay for some time and then reject and leave, it is difficult to get a human birth itself in subsequent births. Even if a human birth is obtained, there will be absolutely no knowledge. Later, by praying to get knowledge, experiencing through many births in some other lineage, they will merge in the position of the Trinity. Another group stands close to the Guru and the lineage, rises quite high on their own, and after reaching a state in that rise where generally no one can find fault, makes a mistake due to jealousy or some other defect in action. The physical condition given to such people will be such that they will not be able to work in any way for the attainment of God. It is also possible that they will have complete devotion and humility in some birth. From that, by giving many births, seeing many Gurus, in a birth where the mind is tired and grieving, God will show mercy and give a healthy birth again and give salvation through it. After searching for it, getting tired and helpless, it will be obtained only through severe sacrifice. There is still another group. Being born through many births, wandering and suffering by worshiping in Shaktheya, Saiva, and Vaishnava traditions for ages, in the final birth they will be among Gurus in two thousand, three thousand years, and then they will achieve elevation according to the arrival of those Gurus. This is only a brief description of the very detailed vision side.

The Path of Dharma Dictated by God

Whatever we do, there will invariably be some shortcomings and injustices within us. What should be the aspects we share collectively to rectify these deficiencies? There are two pathways for this. First, through the meritorious rights (*punyavakasam*) we have acquired by fulfilling the dutiful actions (*karmadharma*) mandated by our householder duties (*grihadharma*). Second, the action that liberates one from the cycle of actions—having traversed the stages of the ascetic (*yogi*), the wise (*jnani*), the dutiful (*karmi*), and the devotee (*bhakta*)—must also emerge from the foundation of the actions you perform. It should not stem from our independent intellect. Instead, each of you serves as the foundational stone to cultivate that fervent thought known as divine will or *Brahmanischayam* within yourselves, and impart it to your young children or the great souls yet to be born. In this, there is no distinction of male or female, young or old. There is no caste, religion, or class.

Today, a situation exists wherein a *Shudra* can access and function in any sphere. However, despite attaining full *Shudra* rights, without comprehending the true essence of a *Shudra*, they continue to gaze upwards, thereby rendering the *Shudra* devoid of true knowledge. Instead of wisdom, mischief, base emotions, and pervasive casteism were imparted to them, and these have now proliferated to an extent where they can never be eradicated. To resolve this predicament, the divine will itself is essential. To become a participant in this divine will, one must inevitably embrace a *Gurumargam* (the path of the Guru).

A pathway for this is precisely what has been revealed to Santhigiri. This path is paramount. The world has never received such a pathway until now, nor will it receive one hereafter. Such a profound ideology has been bestowed upon us as the divine entity itself. It is this very ideology that all preceptors and prophets, residing as indwelling spirits (*antaryamis*), are continuously safeguarding for us. The framework of this action (*karma*) is designed in a manner to procure such protection from those spiritual powers. Henceforth, the requisite discipline, order, and systematic procedure for this must be attained through your traditional adherence to the path. A specific way of life must be formulated to proceed in accordance with this system.

This is not a lifestyle dictated by any particular religion or caste. However, it will serve as a corrective measure to the existing ways of life. Regardless of whether one is a Hindu, Christian, Muslim, Buddhist, Jain, or anyone else, a situation will emerge in the future where they will accept directives from this way of life. This is being offered to the world as our magnificent contribution. For this, you must possess a fundamental understanding.
How can that knowledge be acquired?

This land is fortunate to be conducive to this action (*karma*). If asked how this land attained such fortune, that is an entirely different subject. At some stage in the history of this land, those who lived here must have possessed a certain inherent goodness. Be that as it may, a great fortune has befallen this land. If people, knowingly or unknowingly, deny it, it is not their fault. In the future, this fortune will at least serve them to impart it to their descendants.

Today, quite a considerable number of people visit Santhigiri. Devoid of caste, religion, or class distinctions, what is being shared here with all of them is the complete manifestation of a relentless endeavor aimed at creating a traditional lineage, eradicating the detrimental aspects of actions accumulated over countless lifetimes, and cultivating love, glory, faith, devotion, and dutiful action as a heritage. No matter how much effort you exert to share this, it is never excessive. It possesses a nectar-like glory that remains inexhaustible no matter how long one acts upon it. In order for you all to have the strength to act in this manner, I am conveying this as a declaration.

All of you must unite and embrace this *Brahmanischayam*, without any distinction of male or female, young or old. As the ignorant *Shudra* class, we must undertake it and facilitate others to undertake it to the best of our abilities. Rather than limiting it to the *Brahmin*, *Kshatriya*, and *Vaishya*, we must effect a transformation in all living beings and rightfully claim it for the dawn of the *Satyayuga*. *Kaliyuga* is the era born for us to earn the right to attain liberation in the *Satyayuga*. You must collectively embrace this by reciting a solemn pledge (*satyavakku*).
Solemn Pledge (*Satyavakku*):

Correcting the errors that have occurred to us and our lineage thus far, and turning towards the righteous path—the path divinely granted to us through the Guru lineage—we solemnly vow before the ultimate truth of the Guru that we shall comprehend and introduce that *Brahmanischayam*, which accords with the divine will, to the best of our knowledge, embracing it and handling it appropriately.
*Guruvani*
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Dedication Edition 2002
The Pathway to Purify the Guru Lineages

The primary objective of Santhigiri is to bestow peace and tranquility upon the world. The action we perform for this is akin to dragging a mountain tied with a flimsy thread. If it succeeds, it is a colossal mountain that is moved; if it fails, only a fragile thread is lost. We must cultivate a nature of love imbued with such profound caution. Only after we reciprocally experience and realize the love of that action will we attain true goodness.

No matter how chaotic people may be when they arrive, they become serene once they reach here. The reason for this is the profound glory that has permeated this atmosphere through our prayers. Previously, individuals came here seeking healing for illnesses. Gradually, knowledgeable persons and those inquisitive about spiritual matters began to arrive. That, too, is the fruition of our prayers. The Almighty will grant us double the results of what we undertake. Even the most highly educated person who visits will bow before us. Once, a sage (*sanyasi*) came and remarked that the sublime quality of the air he breathed upon entering these gates was beyond words. The sage also stated that he had never experienced such a deeply pristine atmosphere in any other ashram. That, again, is the powerful result of our prayers.

Because the atmosphere of our ashram is pure, no one with undesirable character traits can simply walk in. There exists a subtle spiritual environment here wherein such individuals cannot sustain their presence. You only need to contemplate on what to do with the time you receive here and how to utilize it properly; the corresponding results will naturally follow. The influx may be minimal, but the divine prosperity (*aiswarya*) is immense.

The chaotic spectacles witnessed in the world today must be obliterated. That is our aim. Even if merely a few among you step out into the society and act, all these turbulences will perish, and both material and spiritual abundance will gain strength in the land. Therein lies God's compassion towards us. While engaging in any action, your resolve must be this: this ideology must endure, bringing eternal peace and tranquility to the world. While working, there should be no egoistic feeling that 'I am the one who did all this or brought this about.' Such an attitude will be detrimental. Whether someone sees it or not, 'I am doing this out of love for God, not to show off to anyone'—this is how you should think. If you think with good intellect and act mindfully, goodness will naturally manifest in your actions without your knowledge. Through your actions, this atmosphere must remain serene, now and always. It must be full of glory. Regardless of who among you does what work or from where, everyone must collectively pray for it to come to the forefront. Those working inside the ashram and those working outside must understand each other and share love. That is genuine love, the true merit.

When one state fades and the capacity for action transitions into another more robust state, numerous obstacles will arise. At that juncture, if you perform dedicated actions completely devoid of arrogance, it will lead to the ultimate goal. There must always be a continuous prayer: "Oh God, may the actions, big or small, that I perform be fruitful; whatever I offer, may it be effective." There will sometimes be moments when devotion swells, the mind becomes full, and resolutions emerge as if catching fire. If you act vigorously at that exact time, all negativities will be severed. Everyone must pray for those who act and those possessing true vision to come forward. That is highly essential for the elevation of this lineage. Through the lineage to the nation, and then to the entire world—this is the expansive nature of this ideology.

Our thought must be how to impart the love of God to these blinded people. Before that, we should also think about what the consequence will be if we worship God and if the love of God arises. We have a misconception that worshipping God will bring complete happiness. Do not assume so. This body itself is the cause of sorrow. For those who worship God, sorrows may come linked like a chain. This is because the latent tendencies (vasanas) residing in us over ages through countless births are being untied one by one. Intermittently, happiness will also come. Weight must be given to that happiness. That is indestructible happiness. However, there are those who live according to what they see without paying attention to any of this, who consider themselves knowledgeable and are considered so by others. We can see them going to places like London and Paris for their own happiness and to bring happiness to others. Only by going there do they find happiness! At the same time, if their own mother is lying sick nearby, they do not even get the time to go and see her. If the father and mother have money, they will find time to inquire about them.

Coming here is not like going to a market, hospital, temple, or to hear a political speech. There is a love here that transcends all of that. Everyone participating in the unbroken chanting of the holy name (Akhanda Namajapam) here attains a sense of peace, knowingly or unknowingly. Those who come here somehow blend in with the practices here. A peace is attained from this atmosphere and from certain individuals standing here. It is an experience that even if it does not translate into action, a sense of peace is attained. The reason for that is God bringing our actions to fruition. You must carefully preserve that compassion. In the future, another goodness will emerge from this atmosphere. That has been accumulated here a long time ago. It is the foundation required for this lineage (Parampara).

What is the nature of this era? It has become corrupted by the spread of demonic nature (Asuratvam). During my childhood, there was a time when producing an unnecessary sound or word was considered a mistake. Today, it is the exact opposite. Today has become an era ruled by the demonic (Paisachikam). God has a determination to change this. To change it, many pains will have to be endured. That pain is first experienced by the renunciate (Sanyasi). He will not get any favorable help, facility, or circumstance for this. The surroundings will be adverse to him in every way. Not only will no one obey him, but the exact opposite will occur forcefully. If he possesses a spiritual side, all demonic forces will accumulate and torment him inexpressibly. However, there is no difficulty where an oracle (Komaram) dances after sacrificing a rooster. Those with the nature of an oracle will not be able to stand here if they come. But there are some Sanyasis who seem to have reached the perfection of renunciation. They are the ones in whom devotion and humility stand strengthened. Such people will unknowingly stay here. The reason for this is that there is not even a trace of the demonic here.

To completely eliminate the demonic, we established a ritual here some time ago. God revealed it as 'Completion' (Poortheekaranam). We have been shown altogether two thousand four hundred and forty-four Gurus and their lineage. Among them, the first seven Gurus in the highest tier have ten thousand crore followers each. The rest have four thousand crore each. We have eradicated all the demonic elements in these Guru lineages. We have also united the Gurus and their lineages in the divine light. It took four and a half years to purify these Guru lineages that stood corrupted in the atmosphere. Even after that, many completions took place. Finally, in 1973, an intimation was received from the Supreme Brahman that what I had desired for aeons was fulfilled. With this, the disciple lineage of these Gurus (from 1973) has been taking birth all over the world. Children higher than them will come and be born in this lineage. All the prayers and intentions taking place here are for that purpose.
Guruvani

Yati Pooja
Sanyasi Pooja Models to be Practiced by the Santhigiri Lineage

Letters should be sent to invite the Sanyasis to the place where they reside, wherever that may be. A money order must be sent for the Sanyasis' round-trip travel expenses. One should go and receive the Sanyasis wherever they arrive, be it the railway station, bus stand, or airport. If they are being escorted to an ashram, they must be given adequate hospitality and accommodated within the ashram itself until the day of the Yati Pooja. On the day of the Yati Pooja, after preparing the Guru Pooja and all kinds of food items, the Sanyasis should be seated on spread plantain leaves or pristine white cloths. First, a garland should be placed around their necks, and flowers must be offered on their heads. Offering flowers means making a coiled ring-like shape with a flower garland on the head and showering flowers over it. Garlanding and offering flowers must be done by the inmates of the ashram themselves. Along with the Dakshina (offering), betel leaves, flowers, and clothes must be given. The Dakshina should be given starting from one end. At that time, mantras from the Gita, Guru Gita, Upanishads, etc., must be chanted. The Ashram President or Secretary must sit with the Sanyasis. Afterwards, food items should be served. If there is remaining space, the pavilion (pandal) can be filled with people and food can be served.
During the time of Yati Pooja, Guru Pooja will be performed for three days in some ashrams and for five to seven days in other ashrams. Clothes will also be provided to the Yatis on those days.

If the Yati Pooja is conducted in a home, the Sanyasis must be received with as much celebration as possible right at the place where they alight and escorted to the house; their hands and feet should be washed, and all members of the household should welcome them together by offering prostrations. After receiving and seating them, something may first be given to quench their thirst. Subsequently, as mentioned above, clothes, Dakshina, food, and travel expenses to return to their place should be given before sending them off.
Meritorious benefits (Punyamsangal) that accrue to the household conducting the Yati Pooja and to that land:

1. The ancestors (Pithrukkal) of those conducting the Yati Pooja will watch all this and rejoice. Ancestors are of two or three types. Those ancestors who have departed as Yogis, Karmis, and Jnanis. They are the ones who rejoice more. Even the ancestors who know nothing and have merged into the atmosphere like primitive humans will attain the eligibility to acquire merit (Punya).

2. The merit obtained is in accordance with the qualification of the guests arriving as Yatis. Yatis start from a certain rank (state). There are Yatis who have reached up to the state of the Trinity (Trimurthi). They are elevated up to a maximum of 5 to 7 states. If the Yatis are those belonging to the timeless Gurus (Kalanthara Gurukkanmar), their ritual will be one that qualifies even for liberation (Mukti). Ten or twenty families among the households belonging to the Guru lineage can also join together to conduct the Yati Pooja.

3. There are those who believe that building bhajan halls, temples, etc., is a meritorious act. Building ten temples will yield the result of building one Samadhi Mandir. If one performs the Yati Pooja understanding its glory and with the purity of its ritual, one will attain the result of building not just one, but three temples. Along with that, ancestors who stand elevated to the zodiac (Rashi) attainable by the Yatis will reach those positions; some will attain liberation and some will take birth. A progeny will be born from the position reached by the life force of any of these Yatis, bringing goodness to the family, the land, and the country itself. These are things that happen over seven generations. If every child in the household worshipping the Yatis does not understand this concept to its full extent, not only will it be impossible to put this into practice, but their lineage of offspring will also travel on the wrong path, becoming the cause for their own and their family's destruction.

Abundant evidence for this can be seen in Kerala itself. The Brahmins who lived in Kalady, where Sri Sankara was born, not only became alienated, but today they are poor in Kerala and, more specifically, in India. Except for those who adopted the dress and language of the Westerners, who were judged as *mlechchas* (outcasts), and engaged in jobs ranging from clerks to bank managers, a few other high-ranking officials, and judges, all the rest are at a very low level today. If this is the condition of the people in Kerala or India who rejected the ideology of Sri Sankara, it can be seen that the experience is no different if one observes people like Kumbalathu Sankupillai, who was foremost among the householders who are said to have respected and revered Chattampi Swami, and who had earned a name and fame in intellect and practical work. Even if one examines the history of the families who loved Narayana Guru, learned and taught by serving him, and the numerous families who first built huts for the Guru in many places and later expanded them, one can see that there are many histories of them being ruined due to the same experiences and many other mistakes. However, it can be seen that those who went and met him once or ten times a month, received the necessary advice and instructions, and humbly obeyed them, prospered and later grew by trying to adapt to that ideology. Thus, numerous families, even without spiritual realization in that path, are indeed great ones who acquired education, wealth, and lordship. Similarly, the land where Jesus was born and the land where Jesus went, grew, and earned respect can be observed by everyone.

Those participating in the *Yathipooja* should chant the *Gurugeetha* mantras and the *Akhandanama* for ten minutes, followed by the *Anukampadasakam* and *Gurukeerthanam*, and finally conclude by chanting the *Santhipadam*.
The Method to Receive and Usher the *Yathis*

At the very front, frankincense (*kuminchan*) should be smoked and carried. Behind that, the lamp and the ornamental umbrella (*muthukkuda*). Following that, the Sanyasins and devotees should be ushered in that order, along with prayers (in a low voice). A bloomed lotus flower should be given into the hands of each Sanyasin.
